name: RegulatoryComplaintCaseManager
tagline: Never miss the regulator's 8-week deadline – from first contact to deadlock letter and ombudsman decision.
description: Complete telecom complaint-handling app in one Power Platform code component: regulator deadline clock with acknowledgement and internal targets, vulnerable-customer handling, case board with business rules, deadlock / final response letter generator, ombudsman (ADR) referral tracking, redress approval and root-cause insights. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Configurable regulator deadline (default 56 days), acknowledgement and internal targets
Drag-and-drop case board with complaint rules
Deadlock letter generator with ADR wording, copy / download / issue
ADR referral window and ombudsman reference tracking
Root cause × category matrix, upheld rate, repeat complainants
Bulk acknowledge / assign / priority, CSV export, undo
Low-code column mapping, Power Fx outputs and events
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
